title: Writing a (valid) C program without main() | iximiuz Labs
excerpt: Walk through the C compilation pipeline: preprocessor, compiler, assembler, and linker. Start with a normal hello world, inspect macros and generated assembly, and end by producing a running binary that has no main() function.
